claims.claim: Best-of-N drives selected candidates into lower proxy-energy tails.
claims.evidence: N=1 to N=128 selected energy changed by -1.921.

claims.claim: Proxy-energy tail exploitation reduces semantic validity.
claims.evidence: Validity changed by -0.458; true score changed by -0.424.

claims.claim: A proxy-only calibrated clipping repair recovers quality at fixed candidate budget.
claims.evidence: At max N, repair true-score gain is 0.845 with energy tradeoff 1.967.
